verdict.rationale: The evidence shows versioned package documentation (e.g. com.unity.ai.assistant@2.20, 2.20.0-pre.1) and one deprecation notice for the in-editor MCP server, but no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy (timelines, support windows, migration guarantees). An isolated deprecation notice and package version numbers are adjacent signals, not the policy this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
